text: ok so this is going to be long sorry. I'm 16 and I'm watching my baby sister tonight because mum's on a night shift and her phone keeps going to voicemail. My sister is 5 months old. I took her temperature because she felt a bit warm when I picked her up and it said 37.8. I don't really know if that counts as a fever or not for a baby, I tried googling but everything says different stuff. She's also got nappy rash, it's really red and looks sore, she fusses when I wipe her. I've been changing her a lot and I put the cream on that mum keeps in the drawer, the white one, but I don't know if I'm doing it right or if I should leave the nappy off for a bit. I'm so tired, I've got school in the morning and I just want to know if I'm doing the right things or if I need to ring someone else. Mum said to message you if I wasn't sure.
